description: Opt-in on top of Pebble's shared Renovate preset: GitHub auto-merge for Payload and Next.js patch and security updates. Only for a repo whose default branch has required checks (branch protection or a ruleset)

packageRules.description: Payload and Next.js patches auto-merge once the required checks pass, unless Renovate marks them breaking (a prerelease step, a 0.x patch); their minors and majors wait for a person

Payload and Next.js security fixes that are a patch or a minor auto-merge once the required checks pass; a major security fix waits for a person. Renovate sets isVulnerabilityAlert from its alert rules, which it appends after every rule here and applies before this rule is read again
